description: Convert pay between hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly and yearly, in either direction, from one amount. Use it for 'what is $25 an hour per year?' or 'what is $90,000 a year per hour?'. It uses hours per week and paid weeks per year (default 40 hours and 52 weeks), so a 2,080-hour year is the default. Amounts are gross, before tax. Use us_paycheck_take_home for take-home pay after tax and overtime_pay for pay that includes overtime hours.

amount_usd.description: The pay you know, in US dollars for the period named by period.

days_per_week.description: Days worked in a week, for the per-day figure. Default 5.

hours_per_week.description: Hours worked in a paid week. Default 40.

paid_weeks_per_year.description: Paid weeks in a year; use 50 or 48 to leave out unpaid vacation. Default 52.

period.description: The period that amount_usd is paid per: hour, day, week, biweekly (every two weeks, 26 a year), semimonthly (twice a month, 24 a year), month or year. Default hour.

name: hourly_to_salary

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Hourly to salary converter
